issues.detail: The corrected PE probe finds 6,643 file-backed RIP-relative instructions but zero direct references to the exact starts of the 54 diagnostic strings. No candidate is proven to be the Galaxy VM execution entrypoint.
issues.nextAction: Use the direct fixture as the source/dispatch gate, then obtain an independently attributable current-version VM boundary in two fresh windows before enabling any hook.

issues.detail: The delayed time-event fixture still leaves GalaxyVibeTrace at seed_marker, while the direct InitMap fixture now writes startup/trace_before/trace_after in fresh ports 6009 and 6012. The observer records one high-volume 0x80000003 IP in the same window but carries no trigger or program id.
issues.nextAction: Keep hook_enabled=false. Add a direct probe without breakpoint; to isolate the game-loop pause, then install a filtered event-source observer before making a VM-boundary claim.

issues.detail: The historical 5983 launcher attempt was blocked by an unrelated SC2 owner, but fresh exclusive launcher-owned windows on ports 5993-5995 reached API readiness and CreateGame/JoinGame without taking over an external process.
issues.nextAction: No owner blocker remains for this stage; continue only with the filtered VM event observer needed for Galaxy correlation.
issues.resolution: Fresh ports 5993-5995 passed the launcher/API ownership gate; the remaining blocker is VM event attribution, tracked by GSVM-GALAXY-BREAKPOINT-CORRELATION.

residual_risks.detail: Promoting a false-positive address could crash SC2 or corrupt a running map; the profile must remain hook_enabled=false until independent verification passes.
